name: Shifter
printedArtCredit: Lucio Parrillo, unnamed Shifter p. 19, verified in the Wizards gallery.
sourceDistinctions: The 2004 first printing supplies six shifting traits and a once-daily free action with duration adjusted by current Constitution and shifter feats.
The original Razorclaw trait describes a light off-hand claw and −2 on all attacks that round when using it with a manufactured weapon.
Wildhunt shifts into scent and gains +2 to Survival outside shifting. Healing Factor adds one duration round as a shifter feat.
The 2006 errata changes an optional feat and prestige class without amending the original racial entry.
Published Warrior 2 Shifters appear in The Forgotten Forge. The staged Ranger and Fighter are original.
portraitForm: Iona Fernridge, an original Wildhunt Shifter Ranger
